ruleDefinitions.name: FileFix - Command Evidence in TypedPaths from Browser File Upload Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects commonly-used chained commands and strings in the most recent 'url' value of the 'TypedPaths' key, which could be indicative of a user being targeted by the FileFix technique. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Explorer\\\\TypedPaths\\\\url1$") AND Details = RGX(".*\\#.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$"))) AND (Details = RGX(".*cmd.*") OR Details = RGX(".*curl.*") OR Details = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR Details = RGX(".*bitsadmin.*") OR Details = RGX(".*certutil.*") OR Details = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR Details = RGX(".*regsvr32.*")))
